message_body: Hello Elena, the approved VEGA-DELIVERY timeline is: design complete 18 September 2026; pilot start 6 October 2026; general availability 14 November 2026. The delivery plan is approved for sponsor circulation before the governance meeting. Approval reference: DG-481.
